roles.name: Tank
roles.description: Tank heroes soak up damage and shatter fortified positions, like closely grouped enemies and narrow chokepoints. If you’re a tank, you lead the charge.

roles.name: Damage
roles.description: Damage heroes seek out, engage, and obliterate the enemy with wide-ranging tools, abilities, and play styles. Fearsome but fragile, these heroes require backup to survive.

roles.name: Support
roles.description: Support heroes empower their allies by healing, shielding, boosting damage, and disabling foes. As a support, you’re the backbone of your team’s survival.

lines: • Base speed limit for Wrecking Ball while retracting Grappling Claw increased by 15%.
• Allied speed boosts now increase the speed limit for Wrecking Ball while retracting Grappling Claw.

minor.d: Plasma Saber hits heal Power Barrier by 40 health.
While holding Power Barrier, Propulsors fuel cost is reduced by 30%.

major.d: Surging Strike gains 125% lifesteal.
Fusion Repeater fires stronger shots with no spread at a slower rate.

minor.d: Eject grants 75 temporary overhealth and Call Mech’s damage radius is increased by 50%.
Hitting an enemy with Boosters deals 40% increased damage and extends the duration by 0.5 seconds.

major.d: Convert 100 health to shields. Defense Matrix restores shields based on 25% of its damage absorbed.
Press R to reduce Fusion Cannons' spread by 75% for 3 seconds.

minor.d: After using Barrier Array, restore 50 shields and activate passive health regeneration.
Increase the range of Photon Magnum by 20%.

major.d: Enemies hit by Crystal Charge's explosion are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds.
While Barrier Array is active, it can be moved one time to another location.

minor.d: Hitting an enemy into a wall with Rocket Punch reloads Hand Cannon and overfills ammo by 2.
The Best Defense grants 25 overhealth from eliminations and its max overhealth is increased by 50.

major.d: Enemies hit by Seismic Slam are slowed by 40% for 2 seconds.
Power Block absorbs projectiles for the first 0.8 seconds of its duration.

minor.d: Jagged Wall hits overfill Spike Guard with 25% additional energy.
Spike Guard's spikes gain 40% Lifesteal.

major.d: Violent Leap's range is increased by 20%.
Bonespur hits mark targets with spikes. Quick Melee and Violent Leap's slash detonate them for 30 explosive damage.

minor.d: Gain Unstoppable and reduce all cooldowns by 6 seconds when using Rampage.
Commanding Shout fully reloads Scatter Gun and increases allied reload speed by 50%.

major.d: When recalling Jagged Blade, its radius is increased by 100% and it deals 30 additional impact damage.
Carnage's impact damage gains 100% lifesteal.

minor.d: Overrun reloads up to 150 ammo during the first second of charging.
Igniting enemies with Incendiary Chaingun grants 50 overhealth.

major.d: Overrun ignites enemies hit.
Critical hits grant Mauga 4 temporary overhealth on Cardiac Overdrive's next use, up to 150 overhealth.

minor.d: Regenerate 100 health per second while charging Terra Surge.
While Fortify is active, Orisa has no movement speed reduction and no heat generation.

major.d: Energy Javelin's knockback is increased by 25% and its wall impact damage is increased by 15.
Convert Javelin Spin to instead launch a barrier.

minor.d: While Nemesis Form is active, eliminations extend the duration by 2 seconds. Half duration gained during Annihilation.
Void Barrier's duration and size is increased by 25%.

major.d: Void Accelerator periodically releases a burst of 6 additional projectiles during continuous fire.
Ramattra is healed for 100 health per second while within Ravenous Vortex.

minor.d: Refund a charge of Fire Strike when you stun an enemy, overfilling up to 3.
While using Barrier Field, your passive health regeneration triggers 75% sooner.

major.d: While Barrier Field is active, use [Primary Fire] to damage and knockback enemies.
For each enemy you hit with Fire Strike, gain 2 seconds of 25% increased attack speed.

minor.d: Chain Hook hits reload 4 ammo.
During Whole Hog, Chain Hook's cooldown is reduced by 80%.

major.d: Take A Breather also heals nearby allies for 50% of its healing.
Enemies in front of Roadhog while Trash Compactor is active are slowed by 30% and take 20 damage per second.

minor.d: Absorbing projectiles with Kinetic Grasp also reduces Accretion's cooldown.
30% of Hyperspheres' damage restores Experimental Barrier's health.

major.d: Every 5 direct hits with Hyperspheres, your next successful Quick Melee levitates and knocks away enemies.
Activate and hold Double Jump to briefly levitate upward.

minor.d: Winston gains 10% movement speed for each enemy he is damaging with Tesla Cannon's primary fire, up to 30%.
During Primal Rage, Jump Pack's damage and area increase by up to 75% while airborne.

major.d: Fully charged Secondary Fire hits bounce to up to 2 additional targets.
Barrier Projector heals allies within it for 30 health per second.

minor.d: Roll impacts deal 100% more damage to Tanks.
Press Q within 5 seconds after using Minefield to deploy 7 additional mines.

major.d: Piledriver winds up longer, gaining air control and dealing up to 50% more damage.
Adaptive Shield generates a 1 second barrier on activation.

minor.d: Secondary Fire's self-knockback is increased by 75%.
Projected Barrier activates ally health regeneration and increases their movement speed by 20%.

major.d: While a Barrier is active, dealing damage with Particle Cannon's beam generates energy.
Particle Cannon's beam pierces enemies.

minor.d: Ignited enemies burn 1.5 seconds longer.
Gain 50 overhealth when you use your Ultimate and for each enemy ignited by it.

major.d: Impacting an enemy with Inferno Rush reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.
Increase the healing of Dancing Blaze's subsequent strikes by 25.

minor.d: After using Dynamite, pressing E again causes it to detonate after a 0.5 second delay.
Knocking an enemy back with Coach Gun allows you use it one extra time within 2 seconds.

major.d: Hitting 2 consecutive scoped shots on a target deals 25 extra damage.
Dynamite has a 40% increased detonation radius while airborne and refunds 6 ammo when thrown.

minor.d: A-36 Tactical Grenade's self-knockback is increased by 25% and no longer damages you.
Reduce the cooldown of A-36 Tactical Grenade by 4 seconds when changing configurations.

major.d: Configuration: Assault's weapon slowly fires explosive shells instead of a rotary cannon.
Press E to rapidly heal yourself.

minor.d: Cassidy throws a second Flashbang that travels farther, but both Flashbangs deal 40% reduced damage.
After using Combat Roll, Cassidy gains a 60% movement speed boost that decays over 1.5 seconds.

major.d: Combat Roll also heals 15 health for each bullet reloaded.
Peacekeeper's secondary fire is replaced with a piercing shot that inflicts bleeding. Combat Roll and Deadeye reset its cooldown.

minor.d: Flight refills Echo's ammo on use, and Echo has infinite ammo during Flight.
Duplicate starts with 30% of its ultimate charge.

major.d: Sticky Bombs fires 2 additional projectiles.
Focusing Beam's range is increased by 8 meters and movement speed is increased by 25% when active.

minor.d: Override Protocol’s light rounds slow enemies by 30% for 1.5 seconds.
Siphon Blaster’s movement speed bonus is increased by 20% while not firing.

major.d: Direct hits with Siphon Blaster refunds 60% heat and increase its duration by 0.1 seconds.
Cyber Frag now sticks on contact, dealing 40 extra damage to stuck enemies.

minor.d: Direct hits with Take Aim refund 5 automatic bolt ammo.
Quick Dash distance is increased by 20%.

major.d: After using Updraft, heal for 30 health per second until Freja touches the ground.
Updraft gains an additional charge.

minor.d: Quick Melee reduces the cooldown of Swift Strike by 3 seconds.
Dragonblade swings gain 30% lifesteal.

major.d: Swift Strike deals 25 additional damage over time if the enemy is below half health.
Regenerate 50 health per second while Deflect is active.

minor.d: Sonic Arrow hacks nearby Health Packs for 30 seconds.
After hitting an enemy with Primary Fire, gain 20% attack speed for 1.5 seconds.

major.d: Press R to ready an explosive frost arrow, slowing enemies hit by 35% for 2 seconds.
On first ricochet, Storm Arrows split into 5 shots dealing 33% damage and bounce 1 extra time.

minor.d: During RIP-Tire, use LSHIFT to gain a quick boost of speed. Doing so reduces RIP-Tire's damage by 50%.
After launching with Concussion Mine, Junkrat gains 35% increased attack speed for 3 seconds.

major.d: Eliminations with Concussion Mine restore one charge.
Frag Launcher's projectile speed is increased by 25%.

minor.d: Allies within Blizzard gain 25% increased movement speed and heal for 50 health per second.
Double jumping creates a small ice pillar that launches Mei into the air.

major.d: Continuously hitting enemies with primary fire freezes them for a short time.
Cryo-Freeze slows and deals 70 damage per second to nearby enemies.

minor.d: Concussive Blast deals up to 30 explosion damage.
Convert 125 health to shields. Direct hits with the Rocket Launcher triggers passive shield regeneration.

major.d: Jet Dash grants 50% fuel. Maximum overfuel is increased by 100%.
After using a movement ability, your next primary fire also shoots two spiraling mini-rockets, each exploding for 30 damage.

minor.d: Collect Soul Globes from dead enemies to restore 50 health.
Leaving Wraith Form grants 30% movement speed for 2 seconds.

major.d: Shadow Step's cast time and cooldown are 25% faster, but the range is reduced by 25%.
Refresh Dire Triggers' cooldown whenever using an ability or reloading.

minor.d: Evade's overhealth duration is increased by 1 second.
Execution does 20% more damage to enemies below half health.

major.d: Joyride instantly restores 50 health and regenerates 20 health per second while active.
Gain all other Damage subrole passives (Recon, Specialist, and Sharpshooter).

minor.d: Increase Anchor Drone flight and grapple ranges by 25%.
Helix Rifle's bullet spread tightens 70% faster and widens 30% slower.

major.d: Anchor Drones hold a medkit that can heal Sierra.
Hitting an enemy with Tracking Shot increases your attack speed by 20% for 2 seconds.

minor.d: Railgun's maximum energy is increased by 50 while Overclock is active.
Enemies hit by Disruptor Shot are slowed by 25%.

major.d: Power Slide generates up to 75 energy.
Power Slide gains an additional charge and its jump height shifts to lateral movement.

minor.d: Helix Rockets' projectile speed is increased by 50%.
During Tactical Visor, Helix Rockets' cooldown is reduced by 80% and no longer interrupts firing Heavy Pulse Rifle.

major.d: Sprint's movement speed bonus gradually increases by an additional 25% over 2 seconds.
Stim Pack replaces Biotic Field. On use, Soldier: 76 heals for 30 health per second and gains 20% increased attack speed for 5 seconds.

minor.d: Sentry Turret gains an additional charge.
Increase the range of Photon Projector's primary fire by 20%.

major.d: Teleporter gains the option to create a forward moving barrier instead. Pressing E again slows down the barrier's movement.
Symmetra regenerates 20 shields per second while within 10 meters of her teleporter.

minor.d: Move 20% faster while Forge Hammer is equipped.
Molten Core activates Overload.

major.d: Deploy Turret's throw range is increased by 25% and it can now attach to walls and ceilings.
Overload upgrades your Turret for 5 seconds, increasing its health and damage.

minor.d: Passive health regeneration triggers 100% faster.
Melee hits reload 12 ammo.

major.d: Health Packs restore 1 Blink charge.
Recall grants 50 overhealth and 20 ammo that decays over time.

minor.d: Projected Edge costs 25% less energy.
Whirlwind Dash continues to spin, hitting 3 more times for 30 damage in a wide area.

major.d: Overhead strikes gain 40% Lifesteal.
Onslaught can stack 3 more times, increasing attack speed by 5% and movement speed by 3% per stack.

minor.d: Drill Dash distance is 75% longer while burrowed.
While Tectonic Shock is active, cooldowns refresh 300% faster.

major.d: Empower SMART Excavator with E to increase its maximum projectile range by 100% for 4 seconds.
Dealing damage with Clobber grants up to 40 Explorer's Resolve shields.

minor.d: Scoped shots cost 3 ammo instead of 5.
Scoped shots charge 100% faster for 2 seconds after using Grappling Hook.

major.d: Venom Mine now fires poison darts at enemies within 10 meters and remains active after triggered.
Scoped shots can charge up to 125%, piercing enemies when fully charged.

minor.d: Invigorating Drones heal for 40 health when applied.
Heal for 50% of damage dealt with Infused Eternal Scepter.

major.d: Reduce Infuse's cooldown from damage and healing dealt.
Sacrifice 25 maximum health. Eternal Scepter healing is increased by 20%.

minor.d: EMP applies Hotfix to all nearby allies.
Teleporting with Translocator while below half health initiates passive health regeneration.

major.d: Hacking health packs with Hotfix reduces its main cooldown by 4 seconds.
Cyberspace's healing is doubled on allies below half health.

minor.d: Sleep dart explodes on impact, slowing enemies and dealing 45 damage over 3 seconds.
Nano Boost grants a 30% movement speed boost to both Ana and her target.

major.d: After exploding, Biotic Grenade bounces and explodes again for 60 damage and healing.
Biotic Rifle can crit enemies.

minor.d: Immortality Field's radius is 30% bigger.
Regenerative Burst now provides Baptiste with 20% increased attack speed for 3 seconds.

major.d: Using any ability triggers Baptiste's Shoulder Turret, periodically firing up to 3 shots at allies, each restoring 40 health.
While airborne from Exo Boots, use SPACE to dash horizontally.

minor.d: Melee attacks against enemies reduce the cooldown of Repair Pack by 0.75 seconds.
Inspire lasts 3 seconds longer when activated by Whip Shot.

major.d: Shield Bash grants 30% increased movement speed for 2 seconds. Inspire's healing is instant when activated by Shield Bash.
Whip Shot's knockback can slam enemies into walls, dealing 60 extra damage.

minor.d: Healing Pylon builds 300% faster and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.
Captive Sun grants Illari 20% increased flight and attack speed, and extends her flight duration by 3 seconds.

major.d: Press [Primary Fire] while using Solar Rifle's healing beam to heal all allies in front of Illari for 100 healing.
Outburst ignites enemies, dealing an additional 50 damage over 3 seconds.

minor.d: 15% of Biotic Pawjectiles healing recovers fuel.
Gain up to 50 extra shield health while carrying another hero.

major.d: Each pulse of Purr contains 3 waves.
Quick melee becomes empowered every 6 seconds, wounding enemies for 40 damage and slowing them by 30% for 1 second.

minor.d: Pulsar Torpedoes lock onto allies 35% faster.
Reduce the cooldown of Pulsar Torpedoes by 1 second for each enemy hit.

major.d: Martian Overboots can now triple jump.
While Glide Boost is active, Mediblaster fires continuously.

minor.d: Healing Ofuda projectile speed is increased by 50% when seeking allies below half health.
Kunai hits launch 2 Healing Ofuda to an ally in front of you.

major.d: Swift Step grants Kiriko 40% increased attack and reload speed for 3 seconds.
Protection Suzu grants allies 30% increased movement speed for 4 seconds.

minor.d: Allies heal 20 health per second while standing on Petal Platform.
Rejuvenating Dash's distance is increased by 30%.

major.d: Quick Melee with Healing Blossom to throw a seed. Another ally can pick it up for overhealth and movement speed.
Thorns detonate for 40 extra damage when enough stick within 2.5 seconds.

minor.d: Wall Riding empowers your next Soundwave, increasing its knockback by 25% and damage by 50%.
Amp It Up is active for 4 seconds after casting Sound Barrier.

major.d: Crossfade's range is increased by 150% while Amp It Up is active.
Gain 15% attack speed while Lucio's Speed Song is active, tripled during Amp It Up.

minor.d: Mercy gains 100 overhealth after casting Resurrect.
Guardian Angel's range is increased by 30%.

major.d: Caduceus Staff's damage boost is increased by 5% and links to a second nearby ally.
Flash Heal gains an additional charge but its base healing is reduced by 10.

minor.d: Remedy Aura generation is increased by 25%.
Hitting an enemy with Binding Chain increases your damage dealt to them by 30% for 2 seconds.

major.d: Healing Kasa bounces one additional time. Each bounce increases its healing by 10.
While Katashiro Return is active, allies within Remedy Aura gain 20% increased movement speed.

minor.d: Coalescence can be toggled between pure healing or pure damage, with 30% greater effect.
Biotic Orb's first 30 healing is instant on each ally it encounters.

major.d: Reactivating Biotic Orb reverses its direction.
Fade lasts 0.5 seconds longer and boosts jump height by 50%.

minor.d: Gain 10 ammo and 50% healing resource when Rushing Torrent is activated.
When you deal damage with water orbs, increase Restorative Stream's passive healing by 30% for 2 seconds.

major.d: Guardian Wave rewinds to its starting location.
Simultaneously control 3 water orbs that deal 60% decreased damage and have 25% decreased empowered explosion radius.

minor.d: Zenyatta gains 15% lifesteal against enemies with Discord Orb.
Activate and hold Double Jump to hover for up to 3 seconds.

major.d: Secondary Fire charges 20% faster and can store 1 extra Orb of Destruction.
Gain a 2nd Harmony Orb but they both heal for 70% effectiveness.
